settings.pump.title: Pump
settings.pump.description: Adjusting the pump to the viscosity of the poured oil
settings.pump.std.viscosity.block.p1: The viscosity choice only simplifies tuning the single-drop output of the pump.
settings.pump.std.volume.block.p1: The optimal setting is an oil volume such that a single drop comes out of the nozzle when the pump operates.
settings.pump.nonstd.block.p1: Set the time parameters for your pump (valve) type. They determine the amount of oil the pump dispenses.
settings.presets.title: Presets
settings.presets.odo.description: Setting the distance between the oil supply to the chain.
settings.presets.tmr.description: Setting the time between oil supplies to the chain.
settings.presets.manual.description: Setting the parameters for the manual chain lubrication mode. In this mode the chain is lubricated only when the button on the control unit is pressed.
settings.oil.title: Oil
settings.oil.description.odo: Asphalt: dose, max speed; off-road: multiplier
settings.oil.mul.hint: The off-road dose is the asphalt dose (with the less/more knob) × multiplier. The preset is selected with the button on the unit.
settings.oil.maxspeed.hint: Above this speed no oil is supplied: the portion is postponed until the speed drops.
settings.oil.km.unknown: Range estimate appears 5 km after refill
settings.oil.hours: Enough for about {p} h of riding
settings.oil.hint.title: How to choose the dose
settings.oil.hint.p1: Oil is supplied in frequent small portions, their rate depends on speed. The knob changes the total dose: each step is ×1.25. Check the chain after a few rides.
settings.oil.hint.dry: Chain is dry and noisy — more.
settings.oil.hint.front: Spray at the front sprocket (sprocket cover, front of the swingarm) — less: more oil than the chain holds.
settings.oil.hint.rear: Spray at the rear sprocket (tire, disc, rear of the swingarm) — check the nozzle contact with the sprocket; the dose is unlikely the cause.
settings.oil.refill.title: Refill
settings.oil.refill.p1: Press after refilling: the level becomes 100 %. If the tank was almost empty, turn the switch on — the unit will refine the pump flow from the oil actually used.
settings.oil.refill.p2: Without a phone: hold the button on the unit for 10 seconds — the LED blinks 5 times.
settings.oil.refill.confirm.empty: Mark the refill and refine the pump flow (tank was almost empty)?
settings.oil.refill.error: The unit did not accept the command. Check the connection and retry.
